candidates.snippet: CTP-ISW will continue to monitor the conflict and provide updates as events warrant. Read CTP-ISW's last analysis about the Houth-Saudi conflict here: https://t.co/eZyRdPkHK3 (5/5)

The Houthis' stated demands are primarily economic and seek to address the dire economic situation in Houthi-controlled territory, but the Houthis maintain a grand strategic objective of controlling at least all of Yemen. (4/5)
